title: Steps to Make Array Non-decreasing
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums, repeatedly remove all elements nums[i] where nums[i - 1] is greater than nums[i] for each valid i.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums, repeatedly remove all elements nums[i] where nums[i - 1] is greater than nums[i] for each valid i. Continue this process until the array is non-decreasing, then return the count of steps taken.
constraints: In one step, simultaneously remove every element smaller than its immediate left neighbor at the start of that step.
Repeat until the remaining array is non-decreasing.
Return the number of simultaneous removal rounds.
hints: The stack stores surviving blockers with the round when each dependent value disappears.
Pop values no greater than current while taking their maximum delay; if a larger blocker remains, current disappears one round later.
Push (value,steps) and track the maximum steps over all values.
Popped elements cannot block current after their own removal; the nearest surviving greater element determines exactly one later deletion round.
editorial: Popped elements cannot block current after their own removal; the nearest surviving greater element determines exactly one later deletion round.

tests.explanation: Successive simultaneous deletions stabilize after three rounds.
The array is already non-decreasing, so zero rounds are needed.
